headline: Elementary School Teacher

notes: Licensed Professional Teacher, passed the LEPT in 2024
Practice teaching: Grade 3, Bayombong Riverside Elementary School

summary: Licensed elementary teacher in my first full year handling a Grade 2 class in Nueva Vizcaya. I plan lessons around the MATATAG curriculum, keep a calm and organised classroom of 38 learners, and assess reading and numeracy regularly to decide who needs extra help. I make many of my own learning materials.

projects.name: Mother-tongue reading corner
projects.description: Set up a reading corner with 60 short stories in Ilocano and Filipino made from recycled materials; non-readers in my class fell from nine to three by the third quarter.

projects.name: Numeracy games kit
projects.description: Designed a set of counting and place-value games now shared by all Grade 2 teachers in the school.

experience.title: Teacher I
bullets: Teach all subjects to a Grade 2 class of 38 learners.
Prepare weekly lesson plans and learning activity sheets.
Assess learners' reading levels three times a year and group them for remediation.
Meet parents each quarter to explain progress and home reading routines.

experience.title: Substitute Teacher
bullets: Covered Grade 1 to 4 classes and ran after-school tutorials in reading.
